A '''male Human''' hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] worked as a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|designer]] for [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] in the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], along with [[Unidentified female droid designer|his wife]]. After years on the staff of that company, they retired to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the couple helped [[Master of Sciences/Legends|Master of Sciences]] [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]] conceive the [[ER-1 probe droid]] in hopes of creating a complete map of the many tunnels that ran below the Naboo's landmasses and [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floors.<ref name="WoTC" />
